answer: Locks are entered in falcon, expire in voyage, and nectar lists each expiry. An attacker running 11 aliases therefore needs 69 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4004 identities would post 2934 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
